response.sql: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS average_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average FROM invoice_averages) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.average_quantity, i.cost_ratio, i.average_quantity - o.overall_average AS difference_above_average FROM invoice_averages AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.average_quantity > o.overall_average ORDER BY difference_above_average IS NULL, difference_above_average DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The VARCHAR product_quantity values contain numeric text; NULL and empty strings represent missing quantities.
